Container.Name: Home-AI-QA-Tools
Container.Overview: Restricted live-read-only Tools service for Home-AI acceptance testing. Mutation permissions are enforced by the application mode; only the exact catalog configuration files needed for read acceptance are mounted.

Config.Name: Host Port
Config.Description: Optional LAN port; keep unexposed unless required by the QA runner.

Config.Name: QA mode
Config.Description: Server-enforced read-only scope. Any other value is rejected by the image.

Config.Name: Standard media writes
Config.Description: Explicit defense in depth; live_readonly also denies mutations.

Config.Name: Tools service token
Config.Description: Private QA Assistant-to-Tools credential; never expose to Open WebUI or models.

Config.Name: QA Tools secret
Config.Description: Dedicated QA-only service token. Do not point at the production token.

Config.Name: QA state
Config.Description: Separate QA workflow and audit state; never share production state.

Config.Name: Plex read configuration
Config.Description: Exact Plex configuration file required for live catalog reads; no Plex appdata directory is exposed.

Config.Name: Radarr read configuration
Config.Description: Exact Radarr configuration file required for canonical movie reads.

Config.Name: Sonarr read configuration
Config.Description: Exact Sonarr configuration file required for canonical series reads.

Config.Name: Lidarr read configuration
Config.Description: Exact Lidarr configuration file required for canonical music reads.

Config.Name: Host metrics
Config.Description: Read-only host metrics; no Docker socket is mounted.
